component.name: Voice
component.summary: Record voice notes and meetings, with transcripts made on this PC

description.p: Voice records from your microphone to Opus files in the Recordings folder in your home folder. Pause and carry on, and press Mark to flag a moment you want to find again; the markers show on the waveform and you can jump straight to them when you play the recording back.

Turn on transcripts and Voice writes down what's said as you record, with the time of each line. They're made on this PC with whisper.cpp: the speech model is downloaded once and checked, and nothing you say ever leaves your PC. Recordings, markers and transcripts are plain files beside each other, so any app can open them. No accounts and no tracking.
